author: codex:engineering
context: INC-0027 exposed context requirement expectations unrepresentable by v3 and rejection scope conflation. Two limited PO judgments did not approve a whole response or new contract; this increment implements the authorized offline migration step.
decision: Explicit evidence-bound requirements retain normative force/applicability. Factual context is not relabeled. Content rejection is separate from project disposition. Preflight recomputes target compatibility and rejects implicit old-case migration. New schemas use an offline supplemental registry to preserve frozen CLI/source hashes.
